title: JAXtari: High-Throughput and Easy-to-Modify Arcade Learning Environment
abstract: arXiv:2610.23650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) has been a cornerstone of Deep Reinforcement Learning research, providing a standardized benchmark for evaluating general agents. However, its lack of native support for object-extraction and environment modification restricts research into evaluating whether agents learn robust causal models or rely on brittle visual heuristics. Furthermore, the ALE's dependence on CPU-based emulation creates a significant bottleneck in modern GPU-accelerated training pipelines, limiting both experimental scale and iteration frequency. In this work, we introduce JAXtari, an open-source, high-performance reimplementation of Atari 2600 environments. By leveraging massive GPU parallelization, JAXtari allows PPO agents to finish training on 100M environment steps on a single A100-GPU in under an hour. translated_title: JAXtari：高吞吐量且易于修改的街机学习环境
translated_abstract: 街机学习环境（ALE）一直是深度强化学习研究的基石，为评估通用智能体提供了标准化的基准。然而，它缺乏对对象提取和环境修改的原生支持，限制了研究者评估智能体究竟是学习到了稳健的因果模型，还是依赖脆弱的视觉启发式方法。此外，ALE 对基于 CPU 仿真的依赖在现代 GPU 加速的训练流水线中造成了显著的瓶颈，限制了实验规模和迭代频率。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 JAXtari，这是一个开源、高性能的 Atari 2600 环境重新实现。通过利用大规模 GPU 并行化，JAXtari 使 PPO 智能体能够在单块 A100 GPU 上于一小时内完成 1 亿环境步数的训练。除速度之外，它还提供以对象为中心的观测和灵活的修改系统，使研究人员能够，例如……
tldr: JAXtari 是一个开源高性能的 Atari 2600 环境重新实现，通过大规模 GPU 并行化使 PPO 智能体能在单块 A100 GPU 上不到一小时内完成 1 亿步训练，并提供以对象为中心的观测和灵活的环境修改系统。
en_tdlr: JAXtari is an open-source, high-performance reimplementation of Atari 2600 environments that leverages massive GPU parallelization to train PPO agents on 100M environment steps in under an hour on a single A100 GPU, while providing object-centric observations and a flexible environment modification system.
